newsitem.title: USA: Jones, AmeriNet merge TV network.
newsitem.headline: Jones, AmeriNet merge TV network.

text.p: Jones Naughton Entertainment Inc and AmeriNet Financial Systems said Thursday they have completed the merger of Jones Naughton's Real Estate Television Network (RETN) with a unit of AmeriNet.
In exchange, Jones Naughton will receive 15 percent of AmeriNet's common stock and other consideration, valuing the deal over $5.0 million, the companies said in a statement.
RETN, launched in August 1994, is a satellite network that provides training and information to real estate brokers and agents in 46 states, Canada and Mexico.

"(RETN) will make us better able to use the real estate office as a marketing platform and create the opportunity for direct satellite advertising of value-priced products and services of interest to the homeowner," John Pembroke, AmeriNet's chief executive said.

AmeriNet develops and provides marketing services and management systems to the residential real estate and financial marketplace through its loan origination videoconferencing system and proprietary software.
